correctness.rationale: Theorem 7 of Almeida–Cardoso supplies 2^4||N, 5^2||N and 31²|N for I(N)=5/2,5|N. For any other prime q|N, I(N)≥(993/400)(q+1)/q implies q≥142, hence prime q≥149. For c=v31(N)=2..5, the exact reduced I(u) denominators are 993,3848,190861,3697932, respectively; their small factors 3,2,11,2 force q<149 (and gcd contradiction), excluding all c<6. Independent Fraction calculations recovered all fractions. Conditional necessary conclusion only: neither existence nor attainable c=6 is shown.

This is a conditional necessary-condition refinement, not existence or a new characterization of the entire class.
